name: clone-hero-charter
description: Self-hosted charting tool for Clone Hero / Guitar Hero style rhythm charts

scripts.// start: next.config sets output:'standalone', which `next start` does not support. The standalone bundle needs static/ and public/ copied beside it — the Dockerfile performs the same two copies as build steps. HOSTNAME is pinned because Docker sets it to the container id, which Next would then try to bind to instead of all interfaces.
